purpose: Core-owned Oura-style readiness knowledge for future SolveOura and external recovery app adapters.

entries.name: Oura readiness adapter facts
entries.summary: Oura-style adapter input may include readiness, sleep, HRV, strain, fatigue, rest, and recovery context.
entries.coreRule: Adapters provide facts only. Core computes readiness, confidence, risk, recommendations, and missing evidence.

entries.name: Future SolveOura app support
entries.summary: SolveOura can render Core recovery output when the adapter and consumer contract are satisfied.
